[P2] Qualify the replay guarantee for child contexts

Completed child contexts can run their functions again: `handleCompletedChildContext` does so when `ReplayChildren` is set, including automatically for results exceeding 256 KiB. Saying completed operations never run again and requiring determinism only outside operations can lead users to put side effects directly inside child-context functions, where they repeat on replay. Qualify the guarantee and explicitly require deterministic coordination code inside child contexts, with side effects inside steps.
